caseName: United States ex rel. T. H. Kessler & Co. v. Title Guaranty & Surety Co.
caseNameFull: United States of America for the use of T. H. Kessler & Company, in Error v. Title Guaranty & Surety Company
summary: In'error to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. James A. Baker, Mr. Samuel B. Dabney and Mr. Claudian B. Northrop for plaintiff in error., Mr. Lewis R. Bryan for defendant in error, submitted.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment affirmed with costs upon the authority of Illinois Surety Co. v. Peeler, 240 U. S. 214, and cause remanded to the District Court of the United States for the Southern District of Texas.
